title: ARMST compatibility policy record
description: Separates researched real-world compatibility from intentional gameplay compatibility. Attachment compatibility and physical geometry are independent.

RealCompatibility.description: Source-backed real-world weapon/mount/module compatibility. Must not be widened merely to match gameplay policy.

GameplayCompatibility.description: Project gameplay family or families intentionally permitted. Example: DovetailRU.

MountInterface.description: Mechanical/serialized interface description. Keep separate from pivot/snap placement.

Evidence.description: Provenance for the real-world or source-project compatibility claim.

GameplaySimplification.description: Explicit statement of intentional gameplay widening/simplification, if any.

AttachmentType.description: Serialized/project compatibility type such as AttachmentOpticsARMST_DovetailRU.

GeometryValidation.description: Independent pivot/snap/offset validation status. A compatible AttachmentType does not prove correct physical placement.

WorkbenchValidation.description: Observed editor/runtime validation. Never infer this from static structure alone.
